notes: Every entry in this log carries the version it arrived in, and for most of them that number was wrong. It was written when the work started, then other releases were cut before it shipped — so the log pointed you at a build that did not contain the thing it was describing.
Twenty-seven entries now name the release that actually contains them. Each one is checked against the release history rather than taken on trust, so the log cannot quietly drift back.

Still to do: the oldest entries carry numbers that were never released at all. They are notes from before the first build existed, and they need a decision rather than a renumbering, so they are left as they are for now.
title: The dev log names the build each change actually arrived in
